Short take: this is 95% solid. I’d ship it with two tiny fixes and one nice-to-have.
What’s great

✅ Uses APP_API_URL / APP_SERVICE_KEY (platform-agnostic) for app code.

✅ Keeps Supabase’s platform keys (SUPABASE_URL, SUPABASE_SERVICE_ROLE_KEY) scoped to the edge function only (that’s correct).

✅ Writer script avoids mutating the JSON after hashing (hash goes to a separate manifest). Good practice.

✅ Backups + UTF-8 no-BOM + PS5-safe. Nice.

Nits to tighten (recommended)
